title: DIGITAL MARKETING PLATFORMS
description: Examines the major digital channels and platforms for digital marketing, theories and techniques of digital marketing, implementation considerations, and associated risks and limitations.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 223, 223H, 390 or 390H.
A minimum grade of C is required in BA 223, BA 223H, BA 390 and BA 390H.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman, Sophomore or Junior may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Sports Business (020)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Marketing (814)
  • Digital Marketing Analytics (903)
  • Applied AI in Business (A047)
  • Sports Business (A050)
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.
